# Getting help with robotsix-board

## Usage questions and general support

Use [GitHub Discussions][discussions] for questions, ideas, and general
support. That's the best place to ask "how do I …?" or "is it possible
to …?" — the whole community can benefit from the conversation.

## Bug reports and feature requests

If you've found a bug or have a concrete feature request, open a [GitHub
Issue][issues]:

- Use the **Bug Report** template (`01-bug.yml`) for defects.
- Use the **Feature Request** template (`02-feature.yml`) for new
  capabilities.

Choosing the right template helps maintainers triage your report
quickly.

## Security vulnerabilities

If you believe you've found a security issue, please follow the
instructions in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Do **not** report
vulnerabilities in public issues.

[discussions]: https://github.com/damien-robotsix/robotsix-board/discussions
[issues]: https://github.com/damien-robotsix/robotsix-board/issues
